claims.assessment: Working support lower bound and omission countermodels; cheaply normalizable

claims.summary: Fixed-depth weakening spines can retain arbitrarily many canonical classes outside the maximal-root input-cover rule
claims.assessment: Exact structural family; not an essential-support lower bound

claims.summary: Every Boolean-point realization of a degree-D design of an unsatisfiable degree-gamma system has at least 2^(D-gamma+1) points; the binary normalized bound is one larger
claims.assessment: Elementary isolating-literal proof, extension-field weights allowed; support-only ENS union bound remains inactive for unary PHP, not a general scalar-map impossibility

claims.summary: Lemma E: for the functional unary base over F_2 in matching normal form with clauses Q_b of degree h and G_e = I_e + sum_b Q_b P_{<=e-h}: if G_B cap P_{<=B-1} = G_{B-1} the normal-form PC closure at degree B is G_B; if this holds at every level 1..B then 1 is not in G_B and there is no PC refutation of degree B; no relation between N and B is used
claims.assessment: Working proof; the general one-level form of the recorded truncated-closure induction (stable filtration, transported and conditioned bit classes)

claims.summary: Theorem T2: for the functional unary base over F_2 (N >= 3) with parity constraints a_b = l_b + c_b whose linear parts are independent modulo the row sums, if no nonzero element of Kbar (image in Lambda^2 V of the span of products of conflicting cells, dim (N+1)(2N^2-3N+2)/2) vanishes on the annihilator U of the forms, then G_2 cap P_{<=1} = G_1, 1 is not in the degree-two closure, and there is no PC refutation of degree two; fails for one-row forms, column sums (the recorded occupancy equations), and is forced to fail when C(d,2) < dim Kbar
claims.assessment: Working proof (top coefficients, Cartan's lemma, idempotence, stability at B = 2); sufficient, not necessary; arbitrary-multiplier analogue of the recorded quadratic-faithfulness tests

claims.summary: 3750 random instances on four, six, eight and sixteen holes (uniform and label forms): the criterion of Theorem T2 never holds together with a degree fall; on six, eight and sixteen holes it fails exactly in the instances with a fall, on four holes also without a fall (2 to 23 of 200 per M); falls from the forced count in every instance (sixteen holes, label forms: none for M <= 53, all for M >= 54); falls before the forced count on small boards are the low-rank events of the first moment; exact enumeration confirms Lemmas R1, R2 in 40 small cases
claims.assessment: Finite check of Theorem T2 only; Theorems U and Lb are asymptotic and rest on their proofs

claims.summary: Decision after the two entries on (HW): evidence and a degree-two proof that generic wide forms do no harm before a count forces it, by a method whose cost is not additive in the number of forms; at degree three and above a fall is an element of the conflict ideal that vanishes on U outside Wbar wedge Kbar_{B-1}, the event "vanishes on U" is dominated by the trivial one (for decomposable elements the two coincide under the criterion), and a first moment needs a rank of B-forms relative to the ideal with a count of low-rank elements, which is not known; (HW) parked next to Question H; next: review of the forms outside the type
claims.assessment: Decision; the degree-B form of the statement is not proved

claims.summary: On arbitrarily large robust bit-label boards, lower MP-fan equations and all same-row boundaries can hold while the cross-closure condition fails, even with a normalized prescribed B component.
claims.assessment: For any d>=1 take a consistent point-evaluation fan, perturb one C component by a degree-d signed trade supported away from its own row, and choose a different-row bit that contracts it to a nonzero (d-1)-trade. Lower data and row boundaries persist, each row fan lifts separately, but no common higher B exists. This local board is satisfiable; no full-source or PHP upper/lower bound is claimed.

claims.summary: Exact F2/F3/F5 point controls verify shared-bottom stratum interpolation and demonstrate failure when the rank-crossing support restriction is removed.
claims.assessment: Finite Boolean evaluation check, not a graph lower bound or a symbolic NS certificate. Bottom forms x,y,x+y and two parents use different rank-one low-span posets. All 24 old Boolean points pass 120 weighted parent companions, 192 coefficient fields, every bottom normalization and 32 support partitions. Removing the boundary-excluding weight yields 3,8,10 failing parent companions across the three primes and partition failures in each field. Complete values, C++ source, commands and provenance are retained.

claims.summary: For J generated by the actual homogenizations of supplied equations, fixed-degree closure W -> W + sum y(W:z) equals ordinary bounded PC; PC and NS agree exactly when the degree-(D-1) kernel of multiplication by z lies in the socle.
claims.assessment: Working all-field exact reformulation with original generator degrees retained. The marked homogeneous PHP algebra is Artinian and its unit z-string records NS degree, not PC degree. Constant-Hilbert flat-family and complete affine ENS controls show why relative unit protection, not full-source no-fall, is needed.

claims.summary: Selector kernel criterion and first-moment identity: with A=F_3[x]/(x^2, collisions, row forms), if the base has no fall through degree 3, the squares l_b^2 are independent in A_2 and ker(Phi: A_1^M -> A_3, (a_b) -> sum a_b l_b^2) equals the Frobenius kernel {(lambda_b l_b)}, then random selectors 1-L_b^2 cause no degree-3 fall; and E|ker Phi| = 3^(M gamma_1 - gamma_3) sum over chi in A_3^* of pi(chi)^M with pi(chi)=Pr[chi(A_1 l^2)=0].
claims.assessment: Working proof of the criterion and identity, and of the obstruction: column forms have l^2=0 in A, so E[#killers] >= B(1+n3^n(1-o(1)))^M and the unconditioned moment is useless; the proof must condition on the spread event dim Ann(l_b^2)=1 and union over non-Frobenius kernel tuples by span dimension.

claims.summary: Merging members: for disjoint hole sets H_1..H_q, the weak unary base plus the merging constraints C_a C_b (a != b in a common H_s) and their placed-pigeon closure (x_ia C_b and x_ia x_i'b, all rows i, i' including i = i') generates the same homogenized ideal as a fat board; with at least (p-1)D^2 holes outside the H_s and m >= D rows it has no fall below D and no PC refutation of degree D (socle criterion), the base plus the unclosed member has no refutation of degree D, and the closed member satisfies hypothesis (c) of relative gluing (its tops are not polynomials in column sums, which matters for (b)). The closure is PC-derivable from the member at degree 3.
claims.assessment: Working proof after a fresh-context review; proves conj:effective-board-stability for merging members in the quadratic range.

claims.summary: Parallel pair fall: over F_3, two complete accuracy-one ENS blocks a, b with h_a, h_b >= 2 inputs and private coefficients, parallel inputs x + c_a, x + c_b (c_a != c_b), other inputs independent, each Groebner-augmented separately, fall at degree 7: R = P_a P_b (q_a - q_b) is not in J in degree 7 while z R is, provided a's false-fiber ideal (its (h_a - 1)-input block, r_{a,1} free) has no nonzero element of degree <= 3 and m(I_a^T) + m(I_b^F) >= 8. Proof by a fiber criterion (G in I_a T iff G_0 in I^T, G_1 in I^F, G_0 + G_2 in I^F for G = G_0 + x G_1 + x^2 G_2) and a true-fiber degree lemma (for h >= 3 the true-fiber ideal has no nonzero element of degree <= 2). Unconditional for 3 <= h_a <= 8, 4 <= h_b <= 8 (false fibers are blocks of up to seven inputs, whose minimum degrees are known from exact Groebner bases); for larger h conditional on every block with >= 3 inputs having no nonzero element of degree <= 4.
claims.assessment: Working proof after a fresh-context review; conditional beyond seven inputs on a single-block minimum-degree statement.

claims.summary: R-added parallel fall (conjecture): two separately Groebner-augmented complete accuracy-one ENS blocks over F_3 with parallel inputs, private coefficients and otherwise independent inputs, with R = P_a P_b (q_a - q_b) added, have their lowest span-ring fall at degree min(h_a, h_b) + 4. Exact checks for h_a = h_b = 3, 4, 5 (lowest falls 7, 8, 9; h + 4 fitted from h = 3, 4 and h = 5 predicted before its degree-bound-10 run); motivated by the pair membership criterion and the observation that the graded true-fiber ideal has no generator other than multiples of rho' below degree h (2 <= h <= 7). If it holds, for h >= 7 the lowest fall is >= 11, so the parallel-pair part of conj:bounded-linkage-large-h would hold at D = 11 for h >= 7.
claims.assessment: Conjecture; exact checks for h = 3, 4, 5 (equal h) and a heuristic obstruction count.

claims.summary: Relative linear semi-regularity (conjecture): on a residual G' with r pigeons of exactly 5 holes, |N(W)| >= 3|W| up to s, D_0 = floor(s/10) and Miksa-Nordstrom operator R, with gamma_d the graded dimensions of Im R filtered by degree, a uniformly random affine forms on the cells of G' keep 1 outside the operator closure W_A at degree D_0 with probability tending to 1 as r grows, for a <= c gamma_{D_0}/gamma_{D_0-1} with c absolute; by lem:relative-criterion FPHP on G' plus the equations then has no refutation of degree D_0. Analogue of the linear case of conj:semi-regular-relative-to-base at its forced-fall count; gamma_1 = 4r; heuristically allows about 4cr/D_0 equations, beyond prop:restriction-ceiling only when r >> D_0 log n.
claims.assessment: Conjecture; no case proved; no finite evidence on sparse residuals (SR's complete-board thresholds are evidence for SR only); a bounded literature pass found no proof.

claims.summary: Pattern-poor support: over F_3, if weak unary PHP^{n+1}_n has a degree-D Nullstellensatz design sum_{x in X} a_x ev_x with X fixed before the prefixes, and P_b(X) is the set of nonzero zero patterns g_b(x) of block b on X (blocks fixed in advance), then for uniform C_b in F_3^{t x h_b}, with probability >= 1 - 3^{-t} sum_b |P_b(X)| every randomized-prefix clause vanishes on X and the design survives, so weak PHP plus all clauses has no Nullstellensatz refutation of degree D (trivial unless 4t+2 <= D). The W_RS analogue of the main record's pointwise-lift support union bound, counting zero patterns instead of points; relaxes prop:bounded-column-vacuity. With |X| >= 2^{D-1} (lem:Boolean-design-point-support-lower-bound), a heuristic count suggests dense families are not pattern-poor on any design support.
claims.assessment: Working proof of the proposition; the dense-family obstruction is a heuristic count.

claims.summary: Single-block falls: over F_3, in R = F_3[y_1..y_h]/(y^3 - y) (functions of a block's form values) with T = gr R = F_3[y]/(y^3): (1) the randomized-prefix clauses C_i = g_i Q generate the vanishing ideal I of the allowed set A_C; (2) for each prefix row j, sum_k c_jk e_k is a top syzygy (q_j Phi contains q_j^3 = 0) that lifts (sum_k c_jk C_k = Q'(s_j - s_j^3), zero in R and in the base closure), so thm:randomized-taylor-glue holds with these prefix-row syzygies added; (3) if the top syzygies over T were spanned by (F1), (F2), prefix rows and (K1), then gr I = (tau), i.e. dim T/(tau) = |A_C| (H-basis criterion), so an excess means non-generated syzygies and a genuine degree fall; (4) hardness of any base plus the whole ideals I_b of all blocks through degree D implies hardness of the base plus the randomized-prefix clauses. In the freeness range T-syzygies tensor up to the board's, so randomized Taylor generation fails for single generic blocks whenever gr I != (tau); W_RS's gluing must use the members' whole ideals (members as units), and A3 for W_RS is gr(sum_b I_b) = sum_b gr I_b through D.
claims.assessment: Working proof after a fresh-context review; the frequency of falls is the finite check ex:single-block-falls-check.

claims.summary: In characteristic zero, at a coefficient point with M>=5 roots in repeated clusters and N-M separated simple roots, the completed centered coefficient ring is the active M-root ring with N-M formal variables, and the complete cyclic defect is its scalar extension. This identifies the double-pair normalization quotient, its kernel K and the residual dimension layer K2. It is an unfiltered coefficient-module comparison: no connection, global grading or order-cost transfer is asserted.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by the cycle's sole medium reviewer. Finite-jet idempotents decompose the EPD cokernel, including diagonal pair components, without treating L(J) as an ideal. Active pair ideals agree under Hensel factorization; support-preserving harmonic comparison and Nakayama kill the simple-root pieces. Translation centers the active factor. Normalization compatibility and the absence of lower-dimensional submodules in the two completed normalization layers identify the dimension filtration.

claims.summary: In characteristic zero, for every N>=6, Supp K2_N equals Delta5 union Delta42 union Delta33, three distinct irreducible components of dimension N-5. The actual polynomial quadruple-double detector kernel has support exactly Delta5 union Delta33. At every exact geometric(3,3,1,...,1) point with full coefficient maximal ideal n, K2 lies in n^2 C and K2/(K2 intersect n^3 C) has dimension4. The universal generic triple-triple transverse length lambda satisfies lambda>=4, with exact value unknown. Writing rho=(N-4)(N-5), rank_A K2>=16(N-4)+5rho and rank_A kerPhi42>=16(N-4)+2rho, hence at six roots at least42 and36. No annihilator, full local presentation or new degree threshold is asserted.
claims.assessment: Working all-dimensional proof passed by the cycle's single fresh medium reviewer. The positive quadratic six-root image transfers under exact formal spectator comparison; smooth-variable length convolution preserves the first differences0,0,4. It forces the entire irreducible triple-triple closure into the residual support. The previous upper inclusion then gives equality. The detector target is supported on Delta42 and vanishes generically on Delta33, so its kernel contains that third component; the previous two-locus kernel bound gives its exact support. Affine removal of the smooth separation coordinate identifies the universal finite-length transverse module and gives lambda>=4. Substituting in the proved exact parameter-rank formulas yields the lower bounds. Complete-module closure/saturation attempts failed and are explicitly not used to infer lambda=4.

claims.summary: First-fall criterion: for W's clauses C_b = g(L_{b,i}) prod_{s in S_b} L_{b,s}^2 on a base P, all with tops of degree d_0 = 2k+2 (C_b is the indicator of clause b's excluded set), a dependency sum c_b tau_b = 0 among the tops lifts (lem:cover-relative-gluing) iff sum c_b C_b vanishes on P; so the dependency classes lift entirely iff dim span{C_b|_P} = dim span{tau_b} in G_{d_0}, i.e. no combination of clause functions is a nonzero function of degree < d_0 on P. A block whose non-prefix forms have the four linear parts of a pencil (x, y, x+y, x-y) has a non-lifting dependency within one member (sum of the four clauses = prod L_s^2 times an affine function), absorbed by closed members; with closed members the exemption of conj:local-generation-modulo-dependencies is the tops'-degree case of conj:shared-piece-falls.
claims.assessment: Working proof after a fresh-context review; places the dependency exemption as the first-degree case of the fall line.

claims.summary: In characteristic zero, the actual centered degree-two residual M_N=K2_N is not free over A_N=k[c2,...,c_(N-4)] for every N>=6. At N6, dim M6/c2 M6>=60 while rank over k[c2] is54, so its vertex torsion T6=H0_(S+)(M6) is nonzero with dim T6/c2 T6>=6 and length>=6. At every exact geometric (6,1,...) point for N>=6, formal spectator extension supplies T6 with N-6 smooth variables, of dimension N-6 inside residual dimension N-5; the residual depth there is exactly N-6. No exact torsion length, global graded relation bound, original order threshold, or positive-characteristic conclusion is asserted.
claims.assessment: Working all-dimensional proof passed by one fresh medium reviewer. The two upper normalization layers are c2-regular, so residual parameter-fibre injection is exact. Six target weights and one possible cyclic relation per weight give a Hilbert lower bound60 through weight21, exceeding independent rank54. Graded PID torsion is vertex-supported; its formal smooth transfer gives depth N-6. A hypothetical A-free module has a four-action graph-Koszul S-free resolution, contradicting this depth. The integer test is a fixed-size falsifier of a uniform mechanism, promoted by proof to every N>=6; no dimension series or polynomial rank computation was used.

claims.summary: For every k>=2 and 1<=t<k, two binary Boolean multiplication-image codes of dimension 2^k-1 have identical complete point-block shortening data, independent input count k, and optimal uniform flag bound (2^k-1)2^-t, but best legal t-row prefix error ranks 2^(k-t)-1 and zero.
claims.assessment: Working elementary comparison passed by the sole medium reviewer. Uses g=(x1,...,xk), h=(1+product(1+xj),x2,...,xk), the full degree-k Boolean multiplier domain, and D>=(t+3)(k+1). Both input spans exclude one. Actual images equal the same-prefix enlarged intersections. The base is satisfiable; this refutes determination of chosen-prefix behavior by these support data, not a hard-family rank bound. The nonlinear tuple has a complete exact-bottom source-shaped realization, not a complete compiler lower bound.

claims.summary: A complete finite acyclic binary product-only ENS source with M blocks, all old input dependence in S of size s and every original accuracy>=t, has no original degree-B PC/NS refutation over proper J_D containing the old base when a surviving degree-b weight has restricted image d_w(S,K)>2^s M 2^-t and b+K+B<=D, B>=2. Coherent random constant rows bound the common bad point set; a degree-K polynomial vanishes there while its weighted image survives. If the full S coordinate algebra injects after weighting, K=floor(s/2), t=ceil(log2(4M)) suffice. Source depth is paid through original B; no outside-support input coverage is asserted.
claims.assessment: Working relative point-count construction and complete original-degree replay; passed by the sole medium reviewer. It allows bad points and chooses the multiplier afterward, unlike the older fixed-design-support union bound. The old base need not be supported S. Inactive generators retain their original certificate costs. The free-cube application is an active all-inventory supported-source class, not a Frege lower bound.
